page_review.title: Void Frame Studio – Animated Classic Door
page_review.author: VOID FRAME STUDIO
page_review.description: Animated classic interior door created in Blender; opening/closing door and handle animation, decorative detail and brass hardware.

page_review.visible_geometry: One white paneled leaf in a molded frame, lever handle, brass hardware and a visible hinge. The animated viewer shows the leaf opening. Full-size dimensions, original handedness and collider suitability are unverified.
